unit.title: Part of me wants to go
unit.titleZh: 想参加，也有一点儿犹豫

Present two sides with 一方面…另一方面

grammar.explanation: 一会儿想去，一会儿又想休息 describes an alternation, not simultaneous action. It is different from 一会儿以后 which says later. The actual duration of each spell need not be fixed.

examples.zh: 她一会儿想去，一会儿又想休息。
examples.py: tā yī huì er xiǎng qù , yī huì er yòu xiǎng xiū xī .
examples.en: She alternates between wanting to go and wanting to rest.

examples.zh: 声音一会儿大，一会儿小。
examples.py: shēng yīn yī huì er dà , yī huì er xiǎo .
examples.en: The sound alternates between loud and quiet.

examples.py: wǒ yī huì er dú , yī huì er tīng .
examples.en: I alternate between reading and listening.

commonMistakes.wrong: 一会儿读，一会儿听就是同时读听。
commonMistakes.right: 一会儿读，一会儿听是交替，不一定同时。

grammar.purpose: Organize two sides of a decision
grammar.explanation: The pattern frames distinct considerations, not necessarily equal weights or opposite opinions. 一方面想参加，另一方面需要休息 does not itself announce a final decision. Hear the person’s decision separately.

examples.zh: 一方面想参加，另一方面需要休息。
examples.py: yì fāng miàn xiǎng cān jiā , lìng yì fāng miàn xū yào xiū xī .
examples.en: On one hand I want to join; on the other I need rest.

examples.zh: 一方面要看时间，另一方面要问主人。
examples.py: yì fāng miàn yào kàn shí jiān , lìng yì fāng miàn yào wèn zhǔ rén .
examples.en: One consideration is time; another is asking the host.

examples.zh: 一方面很期待，另一方面有点儿紧张。
examples.py: yì fāng miàn hěn qī dài , lìng yì fāng miàn yǒu diǎn ér jǐn zhāng .
examples.en: I am excited on one hand and a little nervous on the other.

commonMistakes.wrong: 说了两方面就已经决定参加。
commonMistakes.right: 说了两方面，还没说明最后决定。
commonMistakes.why: Presenting reasons does not establish a decision.

dialogue.title: Two feelings are both real
dialogue.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 周六一起去种花吗？你上次说想去。
lines.py: zhōu liù yì qǐ qù zhǒng huā ma ? nǐ shàng cì shuō xiǎng qù .
lines.en: Want to plant flowers together Saturday? You said you were interested.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我还没决定。最近太累，一方面想出去，另一方面又想在家睡觉。
lines.py: wǒ hái méi jué dìng . zuì jìn tài lèi , yì fāng miàn xiǎng chū qù , lìng yì fāng miàn yòu xiǎng zài jiā shuì jiào .
lines.en: I haven't decided. I'm exhausted: I want to go out, but I also want to sleep at home.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 活动十点开始，不用很早起来。
lines.py: huó dòng shí diǎn kāi shǐ , bù yòng hěn zǎo qǐ lái .
lines.en: It starts at ten. You wouldn't need to get up very early.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那也要带很多东西吧？
lines.py: nà yě yào dài hěn duō dōng xi ba ?
lines.en: But we'd need to bring a lot, wouldn't we?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不用，我带种子。土和工具那里都有。
lines.py: bù yòng , wǒ dài zhǒng zi . tǔ hé gōng jù nà lǐ dōu yǒu .
lines.en: No. I'll bring the seeds. Soil and tools are supplied there.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我手还没完全好，可能不能一直做。
lines.py: wǒ shǒu hái méi wán quán hǎo , kě néng bù néng yì zhí zuò .
lines.en: My hand hasn't fully recovered, so I might not be able to work the whole time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你可以先坐着看，想帮忙再来。累了就休息。
lines.py: nǐ kě yǐ xiān zuò zhe kàn , xiǎng bāng máng zài lái . lèi le jiù xiū xī .
lines.en: You can watch first and help when you want. Rest when you're tired.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这样可以。那我明天晚上再告诉你，好吗？
lines.py: zhè yàng kě yǐ . nà wǒ míng tiān wǎn shang zài gào sù nǐ , hǎo ma ?
lines.en: That sounds manageable. Can I let you know tomorrow evening?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，别为了陪我就勉强自己。
lines.py: hǎo , bié wèi le péi wǒ jiù miǎn qiǎng zì jǐ .
lines.en: Sure. Don't push yourself just to keep me company.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 知道了。你倒是别太早睡，明天记得看消息。
lines.py: zhī dào le . nǐ dǎo shì bié tài zǎo shuì , míng tiān jì de kàn xiāo xī .
lines.en: I know. Don't go to bed too early yourself; check my message tomorrow.
lines.speaker: b

choices: A morning visit with breaks and optional help
A promise to work all day without rest

reading.title: Reasons before a decision
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 周五晚上，我告诉朋友周六想一起去种花。我没有答应做一整天，只想上午去看看。
lines.py: zhōu wǔ wǎn shang , wǒ gào sù péng you zhōu liù xiǎng yì qǐ qù zhǒng huā . wǒ méi yǒu dā yìng zuò yī zhěng tiān , zhǐ xiǎng shàng wǔ qù kàn kàn .
lines.en: Friday evening I told my friend I'd join Saturday's planting. I hadn't offered a full day's work, just a morning visit.

lines.zh: 十点到那里时，已经有几个人在准备。朋友把种子放好，我坐在旁边听他们介绍。
lines.py: shí diǎn dào nà lǐ shí , yǐ jīng yǒu jǐ gè rén zài zhǔn bèi . péng you bǎ zhǒng zi fàng hǎo , wǒ zuò zài páng biān tīng tā men jiè shào .
lines.en: At ten several people were preparing. My friend set out the seeds; I sat nearby and listened to the introduction.

lines.zh: 我试着把一点土放进小盒子，手有些累，就停下来。朋友没有催我，只把椅子往树下挪了一点。
lines.py: wǒ shì zhe bǎ yī diǎn tǔ fàng jìn xiǎo hé zi , shǒu yǒu xiē lèi , jiù tíng xià lái . péng you méi yǒu cuī wǒ , zhǐ bǎ yǐ zi wǎng shù xià nuó le yī diǎn .
lines.en: I tried putting some soil in a small box, but my hand tired, so I stopped. My friend didn't hurry me; she moved my chair into the shade.

lines.zh: 休息了一会儿，我又过去帮她把名字写在纸上。做不了重的工作，也可以做一点别的。
lines.py: xiū xī le yī huì er , wǒ yòu guò qù bāng tā bǎ míng zi xiě zài zhǐ shàng . zuò bù le zhòng de gōng zuò , yě kě yǐ zuò yī diǎn bié de .
lines.en: After a rest I helped label the plants. Even without doing heavy work, there were other little things I could do.

lines.zh: 中午有人问我们要不要留下吃饭。我下午还想休息，就和朋友先回去了。她说下周再来看看花有没有长出来。
lines.py: zhōng wǔ yǒu rén wèn wǒ men yào bù yào liú xià chī fàn . wǒ xià wǔ hái xiǎng xiū xī , jiù hé péng you xiān huí qù le . tā shuō xià zhōu zài lái kàn kàn huā yǒu méi yǒu zhǎng chū lái .
lines.en: At noon we were invited to stay for lunch. I wanted an afternoon rest, so we headed home. My friend suggested checking next week whether anything had sprouted.

lines.zh: 回家以后，我给她发了今天拍的照片。小盒子里的土还没变化，照片里大家的笑倒是很清楚。
lines.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ gěi tā fā le jīn tiān pāi de zhào piān . xiǎo hé zi lǐ de tǔ hái méi biàn huà , zhào piān lǐ dà jiā de xiào dǎo shì hěn qīng chǔ .
lines.en: At home I sent her our photos. The soil in the little boxes hadn't changed yet, but everyone's smiles were clear.

Only watching without helping at all

lines.zh: 你说今天只是看看，怎么也种了一盒？
lines.py: nǐ shuō jīn tiān zhǐ shì kàn kàn , zěn me yě zhǒng le yī hé ?
lines.en: You said you were only watching. How did you plant a whole box?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 看着看着就想试了嘛。
lines.py: kàn zhe kàn zhe jiù xiǎng shì le ma .
lines.en: Watching made me want to try.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那下周来看看你种的花？
lines.py: nà xià zhōu lái kàn kàn nǐ zhǒng de huā ?
lines.en: Want to check your flowers next week?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先别叫它花，现在还只有土。
lines.py: xiān bié jiào tā huā , xiàn zài hái zhǐ yǒu tǔ .
lines.en: Don't call it a flower yet. It's only soil for now.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，看看你种的土。
lines.py: xíng , kàn kàn nǐ zhǒng de tǔ .
lines.en: Fine. Let's check the soil you planted.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你这个说法，我听着怎么更奇怪了。
lines.py: nǐ zhè gè shuō fǎ , wǒ tīng zhe zěn me gèng qí guài le .
lines.en: Somehow that sounds even stranger.
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: tā yì fāng miàn gāo xìng , lìng yì fāng miàn yòu yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng .
lines.en: She's happy but also a little nervous.

lines.zh: 她现在任这所学校的校长。
lines.py: tā xiàn zài rèn zhè suǒ xué xiào de xiào zhǎng .
lines.en: She's now the principal of this school.

lines.zh: 他曾经任我们队的队长。
lines.py: tā céng jīng rèn wǒ men duì de duì zhǎng .
lines.en: He used to be our team captain.

lines.zh: 这个办法受到了大家的欢迎。
lines.py: zhè gè bàn fǎ shòu dào le dà jiā de huān yíng .
lines.en: This approach was welcomed by everyone.

lines.zh: 她受了很大的影响。
lines.py: tā shòu le hěn dà de yǐng xiǎng .
lines.en: She was greatly influenced.

lines.zh: 他的手昨天受伤了。
lines.py: tā de shǒu zuó tiān shòu shāng le .
lines.en: He injured his hand yesterday.

lines.zh: 我没受伤，只是有点累。
lines.py: wǒ méi shòu shāng , zhǐ shì yǒu diǎn lèi .
lines.en: I'm not injured, just a little tired.

lines.zh: 请往后退一点。
lines.py: qǐng wǎng hòu tuì yī diǎn .
lines.en: Please move back a little.

lines.zh: 她看到车过来，退了两步。
lines.py: tā kàn dào chē guò lái , tuì le liǎng bù .
lines.en: She stepped back twice when the vehicle approached.

lines.zh: 我想退出这次活动。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng tuì chū zhè cì huó dòng .
lines.en: I'd like to withdraw from this event.

lines.zh: 他退出了比赛，但留下来看朋友。
lines.py: tā tuì chū le bǐ sài , dàn liú xià lái kàn péng you .
lines.en: He withdrew from the competition but stayed to watch his friend.

lines.zh: 这里的水很深。
lines.py: zhè lǐ de shuǐ hěn shēn .
lines.en: The water's deep here.

lines.zh: 这个盒子比那个深。
lines.py: zhè gè hé zi bǐ nà gè shēn .
lines.en: This box is deeper than that one.

lines.zh: 那次见面给我留下了深刻的印象。
lines.py: nà cì jiàn miàn gěi wǒ liú xià le shēn kè de yìn xiàng .
lines.en: That meeting left a deep impression.

lines.zh: 她的话让我印象深刻。
lines.py: tā de huà ràng wǒ yìn xiàng shēn kè .
lines.en: Her words made a deep impression on me.

lines.zh: 我想深入了解这个地区。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng shēn rù liǎo jiě zhè gè dì qū .
lines.en: I'd like to learn more deeply about this region.

lines.zh: 他们深入讨论了这个问题。
lines.py: tā men shēn rù tǎo lùn le zhè gè wèn tí .
lines.en: They discussed this issue in depth.

lines.zh: 屋子里很温暖。
lines.py: wū zi lǐ hěn wēn nuǎn .
lines.en: It's warm in the room.

lines.zh: 朋友的关心让我觉得温暖。
lines.py: péng you de guān xīn ràng wǒ jué de wēn nuǎn .
lines.en: My friend's care made me feel warmth.

lines.zh: 跟家人在一起，我觉得很幸福。
lines.py: gēn jiā rén zài yì qǐ , wǒ jué de hěn xìng fú .
lines.en: I feel happy with my family.

lines.zh: 她说现在的生活很幸福。
lines.py: tā shuō xiàn zài de shēng huó hěn xìng fú .
lines.en: She says her life is happy now.

lines.zh: 我很幸运，遇到了愿意帮我的人。
lines.py: wǒ hěn xìng yùn , yù dào le yuàn yì bāng wǒ de rén .
lines.en: I was lucky to meet someone willing to help.

lines.zh: 今天真幸运，一出门就有车。
lines.py: jīn tiān zhēn xìng yùn , yī chū mén jiù yǒu chē .
lines.en: What luck: a vehicle arrived as soon as I went out.

lines.zh: 门上贴着一个红色的福字。
lines.py: mén shàng tiē zhe yī gè hóng sè de fú zì .
lines.en: A red character meaning good fortune is displayed on the door.

lines.zh: 奶奶说，平安也是一种福。
lines.py: nǎi nai shuō , píng ān yě shì yī zhǒng fú .
lines.en: Grandma says peace and safety are also a blessing.

lines.zh: 这个土豆还是生的，没煮好。
lines.py: zhè gè tǔ dòu hái shi shēng de , méi zhǔ hǎo .
lines.en: This potato's still raw; it isn't cooked through.

lines.zh: 生的东西和熟的分开放。
lines.py: shēng de dōng xi hé shú de fēn kāi fàng .
lines.en: Keep raw and cooked foods separate.

lines.zh: 这本书讲植物的生命。
lines.py: zhè běn shū jiǎng zhí wù de shēng mìng .
lines.en: This book is about plant life.

lines.zh: 他把时间都用来研究生命。
lines.py: tā bǎ shí jiān dōu yòng lái yán jiū shēng mìng .
lines.en: He devotes his time to studying life.

lines.zh: 这种植物在冷的地方也能生存。
lines.py: zhè zhòng zhí wù zài lěng de dì fāng yě néng shēng cún .
lines.en: This plant can survive in cold places.

lines.zh: 没有水，植物很难生存。
lines.py: méi yǒu shuǐ , zhí wù hěn nán shēng cún .
lines.en: Plants struggle to survive without water.

lines.zh: 这些花正在慢慢生长。
lines.py: zhè xiē huā zhèng zài màn màn shēng zhǎng .
lines.en: These flowers are growing slowly.

lines.zh: 这种树生长得很快。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng shù shēng zhǎng de hěn kuài .
lines.en: This kind of tree grows quickly.

lines.zh: 盒子里还有一点土。
lines.py: hé zi lǐ hái yǒu yī diǎn tǔ .
lines.en: There's still some soil in the box.

lines.zh: 他把种子放进土里。
lines.py: tā bǎ zhǒng zi fàng jìn tǔ lǐ .
lines.en: He put the seeds in the soil.

lines.zh: 这些种子是朋友送的。
lines.py: zhè xiē zhǒng zi shì péng you sòng de .
lines.en: These seeds were a gift from a friend.

lines.zh: 种子还没长出来，我们再等几天。
lines.py: zhǒng zi hái méi zhǎng chū lái , wǒ men zài děng jǐ tiān .
lines.en: The seeds haven't sprouted; let's wait a few more days.

lines.zh: 我现在头脑很清楚，可以继续工作。
lines.py: wǒ xiàn zài tóu nǎo hěn qīng chǔ , kě yǐ jì xù gōng zuò .
lines.en: My mind's clear now; I can keep working.

lines.zh: 休息以后，他的头脑清楚多了。
lines.py: xiū xī yǐ hòu , tā de tóu nǎo qīng chǔ duō le .
lines.en: His mind was much clearer after resting.

lines.zh: 这里太危险，我们换一条路。
lines.py: zhè lǐ tài wēi xiǎn , wǒ men huàn yī tiáo lù .
lines.en: It's too dangerous here; let's take another road.

lines.zh: 这种动作有危险，先问教练。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng dòng zuò yǒu wēi xiǎn , xiān wèn jiào liàn .
lines.en: This movement can be dangerous; ask the coach first.

audio.zh: 不用，我带种子。土和工具那里都有。
audio.py: bù yòng , wǒ dài zhǒng zi . tǔ hé gōng jù nà lǐ dōu yǒu .
audio.en: No. I'll bring the seeds. Soil and tools are supplied there.
